ios.desc:
Bebilog is the all-in-one newborn tracker for feeding, sleep, diapers, growth, milestones, and more, and the only baby logger built with full preemie support.

Track every breastfeeding session, bottle feed, nap, diaper change, and milestone in seconds. No account, no ads, no data sent anywhere, ever.

— TRACK EVERYTHING IN ONE PLACE —

• Feeding: Breastfeeding timer, bottle, and solid food with amounts and duration
• Sleep: Naps and nighttime sleep tracker with start/end times
• Diapers: Wet, dirty, and mixed changes at a glance
• Growth: Weight, height, and head circumference with WHO growth charts
• Temperature: Body temperature with fever alerts
• Vaccines: Recommended schedules and dose log
• Medicine: Dosage, frequency, and reminders
• Pumping: Duration, amount, and side
• Milestones: First smile to first steps
• Photos & Videos: Attach media to any record

— BUILT FOR PREEMIES —

Bebilog is the only baby tracker with full premature baby mode. When your baby is born before 37 weeks, Bebilog automatically:

• Displays corrected age alongside actual age
• Switches to INTERGROWTH-21st preterm growth charts
• Adjusts milestone timing to corrected age
• Tracks NICU-relevant metrics

If you're tracking a preemie, you've probably struggled with apps that pretend term and preterm are the same. Bebilog doesn't.

— BEAUTIFUL INSIGHTS —

Daily, weekly, and monthly summaries with clear charts. Feeding patterns, sleep trends, and growth percentiles against WHO and INTERGROWTH-21st standards.

— PRIVACY-FIRST, OFFLINE-FIRST —

All data stored locally on your device. No analytics, no ads, no tracking, no cloud servers. We never see your data. Period.

— STAY ON SCHEDULE —

Reminders for feedings, medications, vaccines, and appointments. Manage multiple medication and pumping schedules.

— MULTIPLE BABIES —

Tracking twins or siblings? Bebilog supports multiple profiles with easy switching.

— 31 LANGUAGES —

Fully translated into 31 languages including English, Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Simplified and Traditional Chinese, Portuguese, Italian, and more.

— EXPORT YOUR DATA —

Export all records as CSV anytime. Your data belongs to you.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://petrguan.github.io/Bebilog-privacy-policy/

quotes.text:
I just became a father and feel like it could be helpful if I have an app tracking my son's status. He has premature birth and we're all very worried about him.

I don't want my son's data to be sent to any 3rd party so I vibe coded: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/bebilog/id6759827652
